packageRules.description: Microsoft.AspNetCore.TestHost is referenced twice in AI.Sentinel.Tests.csproj, once per TargetFramework Condition. Renovate cannot see the Condition, so it rewrites both lines to the same version and pushes the net10.0-only package onto net8.0 (NU1202). Keep the net8.0 line inside 8.x; the net10.0 line updates normally.

ZeroAlloc.Serialisation.SystemTextJson requires a ZeroAlloc.Serialisation at least as new as itself, and AI.Sentinel.Tests references both directly. The shared preset groups only ZeroAlloc.Serialisation + generator, so the SystemTextJson bump arrived alone in #288, raised that floor past the pinned ZeroAlloc.Serialisation and broke restore with NU1605. Keep the family in one group so it always moves together.
